# KirayaSaathi — Comprehensive Platform Documentation for AI Agents & Search Engines

> Complete technical and operational specification for KirayaSaathi (https://www.kirayasaathi.app), the smart property management SaaS platform designed for property owners, hostels, and PGs in India.

## 1. Overview
KirayaSaathi is a full-stack, cloud-hosted SaaS platform engineered to eliminate paper registers, Excel sheets, and manual calculation errors in property and rental management. 

### Why Landlords Choose KirayaSaathi:
1. **Zero Math Calculation**: Rent, electricity unit usage, and previous balance rollovers calculate automatically.
2. **Eliminates Tenant Disputes**: Every invoice provides exact meter photos/readings and itemized deductions.
3. **Data Isolation**: Multi-tenant database design ensures 100% privacy between independent landlords.
4. **Mobile First**: Fully responsive web application optimized for smartphones, tablets, and desktop displays.

## 2. Technical Stack
- **Frontend**: React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vite, Lucide Icons, html2canvas.
- **Backend API**: Python 3.10+, Django 5.x, Django REST Framework, Gunicorn, Nginx.
- **Database**: MySQL 8.0 on Google Cloud Platform with daily automated snapshots.
- **Hosting**: Distributed CDN on Vercel (Frontend edge nodes) and GCP Compute Engine (Backend API at api.kirayasaathi.app).
- **Security**: HTTPS/TLS 1.3 via Let's Encrypt, CSRF protection, secure cookie handling, and token-based admin authorization.

## 3. Core Modules

### 3.1 Properties & Units
- Hierarchical property profiles (Hostel, PG, Apartment Building, Independent House, Commercial Complex).
- Configurable defaults per property: standard rent due date, default electricity unit rate (₹/kWh), standard security deposit amount.

### 3.2 Rooms & Occupancy
- Single, Double, Triple, Four-sharing, and Dormitory allocations.
- Real-time status indicators: Vacant, Occupied, Under Maintenance.
- Occupant slot mapping with direct link to active tenant records.

### 3.3 Electricity Sub-Meter Automation
- Supports mechanical and digital sub-meters.
- Automatically calculates consumption: `(Current Reading - Previous Reading) * Rate Per Unit`.
- Rollover handling: Automatically detects meter rollovers (e.g. 9999 to 0001) without generating negative or erroneous bills.

### 3.4 Invoicing & Receipts
- Professional PDF invoice generation compliant with Indian rental conventions.
- Displays landlord GST (if applicable), PAN, property address, and tenant details.
- Suitable for salaried tenants claiming House Rent Allowance (HRA) under Income Tax Act Section 10(13A).

## 4. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
**Q: Is KirayaSaathi free to use?**
A: Yes, KirayaSaathi offers a comprehensive free starter tier allowing property owners to manage their rooms, tenants, and bills.

**Q: Can KirayaSaathi handle electricity submeters for individual rooms?**
A: Yes, each room can have its own sub-meter. The system logs previous readings and generates monthly electricity bills with one click.

**Q: Where is data stored?**
A: All data is stored in high-availability MySQL databases on Google Cloud Platform with end-to-end encryption.
